primary_result: All 100 canonical Haze4K development scenes and 400 nested haze conditions completed with exact structural controls. Mean worst-held-out-grid conditional PSNR regret was 0.1423 dB; its one-sided 95 percent scene-bootstrap lower and upper bounds were 0.1253 and 0.1599 dB. The lower bound exceeded the frozen 0.10 dB maximum, while the achieved upper-bound distance was 0.0176 dB versus the 0.05 dB precision limit. This is a scientific FAIL: conditioning on observed haze greatly reduced the parent cross-variant regret but did not qualify the fixed tile/action target.
gate_reasons: The primary regret clearly failed: the one-sided 95 percent lower bound was 0.1253 dB, above the frozen 0.10 dB maximum; achieved precision itself was adequate at 0.0176 dB.
All source and common-nonclipped grid projections, structural keep identity, nonclipped affine manipulation, 100-scene grouping, and no-training/protected-data controls passed.
Material coverage passed in 97/100 scenes with Wilson lower bound 0.9155 above 0.20.
Location specificity and non-clipping direction passed with one-sided 95 percent lower bounds 1.7223 dB and 1.6989 dB.
SSIM and color tail safety passed: harm occurred in 4/100 and 3/100 scenes, with Wilson upper bounds 0.0984 and 0.0845 below 0.10.
No predictor or network was trained, and candidate-confirmation data, NH-HAZE, canary data, and locked-test data were not delivered or accessed.
competing_explanation: The large reduction from the archived 1.0269 dB cross-variant regret to 0.1423 dB shows that treating haze variants as substantive conditions removed most, but not all, target instability. The remaining precisely estimated excess regret is consistent with aliasing from the fixed 32-pixel tile unit or an action set too coarse for boundary regions; it is not explained by missing coverage, clipping direction, spatial misalignment, or the registered SSIM/color tails. Because GT defines both source utility and the held-out-grid oracle, this result does not identify deployment-time predictability or a physical haze mechanism.
limitations: This is development-screening evidence from 100 canonical synthetic Haze4K scenes, not candidate confirmation or real-haze external validation.

The pre-run precision certificate was descriptive-capacity and infeasible at n=100 under the conservative parent SD, although the observed primary upper-bound distance met the frozen achieved-precision limit.
The four haze variants are observed conditions within scene, and grid origins, tiles, pixels, and metrics are not independent samples.
RGB reconstruction, SSIM, and channel-bias endpoints do not establish general perceptual quality.
The conclusion is specific to the fixed scales 0.8, 1.0, and 1.2 and the four declared 32-pixel grid origins; it authorizes no stage 2 experiment.
